facts.fact: The national Datacenter de Diamniadio, run by ADIE (now Senegal Numerique SA), was inaugurated and put into service on 22 June 2021, with a 250 m2 space reserved for the national and international private sector alongside one for the administration.
ADIE states that the Diamniadio national Datacenter, inaugurated 22 June 2021 and in service, is the state's first Tier 3 data centre (operator's own statement, no certifier named).
